title: SpecMaker Specs aggregate
description: The spec root's architectural vocabulary: buckets and subdomains. The Spec entity's own fields live at the root of a spec document (see spec.schema.json), not here.

Bucket.description: One of the five architecture buckets. Modelled as rows rather than an enum so a spec can declare sub-buckets (e.g. "Side Effects / HTTP adapters") without a schema change.

kind.description: The architecture bucket this belongs to, e.g. framework, ui_component, side_effect, domain, manager.
